newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela planning min denies he plans to resign.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela planning min denies he plans to resign.

text.p: Venezuelan Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff on Thursday denied rumors he was resigning from his post, and attributed the false reports, first circulated by a local tabloid, to government opponents.
"They probably stemmed from opponents of the country's economic program," Petkoff told reporters.
"What such people don't take into account is that it damages the country...which is beginning to show signs of a speedy and sustained recovery."
Petkoff, who returned from a promotional tour of Europe Wednesday night, spoke earlier Thursday afternoon to the Caracas stock exchange in an attempt to ease concerns among traders and investors.
Traders said share prices had fallen investors, especially foreign ones, sold on the talk of his possible resignation.
